hooks.name: tsx-copy-safety
hooks.description: Keep apostrophes valid and do not weaken STAY language after UI edits.

action.prompt: This TypeScript/TSX file was just saved. Check two things only: (1) no unescaped apostrophe inside a single-quoted string, (2) if the file touches GO/CAUTION/STAY or gale copy, STAY still means do not leave when the sea is dangerous. Fix only those issues. Do not refactor.
